messages:
allhands-bot: Starting the follow-up thread for today's all-hands strategy Q&A. Drop clarifying questions here.
jamie_ceo: I'll keep replies short here; we'll publish a consolidated FAQ after.
sam_product: Quick: what's the one-sentence differentiation vs big cloud providers?
jamie_ceo: We're a production-first inference platform: predictable latency, cost controls, and the same dev experience across hosted/dedicated/private.
lee_growth: Customers worry about vendor lock-in if we push Dedicated. Thoughts?
maria_sales: Reassure them: same API and migration tooling, exportable configs, and a clear migration playbook. We don't lock users to a proprietary model format.
yusuf_strategy: Competitor tactic: some vendors tout "exclusive models" as moat. Should we respond publicly?
jamie_ceo: Be factual, not combative. Highlight serving economics and transparent perf profiles. Offer benchmarks and migration stories.
olivia_cto: Technical angle: call out our smart routing + KV caching as hard-to-copy operating value. That resonates with infra teams.
sam_product: Action items? Who owns the public FAQ and benchmark kit?
jamie_ceo: Olivia owns benchmark kit, Sam + Lee own the FAQ/messaging, Maria helps with customer-facing slides. I'll review drafts by EOD Friday.
lee_growth: I'll draft three concise positioning bullets for sales to use.
jamie_ceo: Thanks all — post follow-ups here or schedule a runbook session.
